entities.summary: Armenian, a notable figure in the history of Armenia, associated with Artaxiad Dynasty and Tigranes the Great (95 BCE–55 BCE). Preceded by Defeat by Lucullus at Tigranocerta and submission to Pompey (69–66 BC) and Tigranes crowned 'King of Kings' and builds Tigranocerta (c. 83 BC). Their legacy influenced Roman-Armenian Rivalry.
